reminders.title: Reminder: ship 0.2.3 before WordPress 7.2 comes out (scheduled December 8)
reminders.body:
WordPress 7.2 is scheduled for **December 8, 2026** (release candidate 1 on November 17). Once it ships, sites on 7.2 see the plugin as "Untested with your version of WordPress", and Plugin Check fails CI on the old "Tested up to".

**What goes into 0.2.3:**
- The `{path}` fix: paths with percent-encoded characters are no longer cut short (`/caf%C3%A9/` became `/caf`).
- The settings screen's inline styles move into the stylesheet (no visible change), plus the two small fixes the tests found.
- "Tested up to: 7.2".
- Plugin URI: a page about the plugin on localpr.com (the page has to exist first).
- A credit line at the bottom of the plugin's own settings page only (mockups first).
- Author URI: https://localpr.com/dani-owens/

**Steps:**
1. Start a release branch from `main` with the changes above.
2. From 7.2 RC1, test against it and set "Tested up to: 7.2".
3. CI, the dry run, then tag `0.2.3`.

Close this issue when 0.2.3 is on WordPress.org.
